verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm. It sells legal advisory services such as venture financings, IP, employment and privacy counsel, and it does not offer a software product that analyzes user data. In-product AI-generated insights are therefore a category error for this kind of offering. The Clerky formation partnership is a third-party document-workflow platform, and the evidence shows no AI-insight capability in it either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
